Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account to create and no newsletter to sign up for. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Many are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site allows family-friendly games only, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Your recently played games, favourites, light or dark choice and most games' own progress stay on your device and never leave it. Clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose them.
Why am I asked about cookies?
Visitors in Europe are asked before any non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings in the footer.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If it still will not start, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is. Include the name of the game so we can look into it.
Where do the games come from?

There are about 12,477 games. 6 are made by Door 404, our own studio in Novi Sad, Serbia. Others are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 46 were sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive, at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and an accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will remove it. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
You can embed the games made by Door 404. Each has an Embed this game box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded from here.
